To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed an analytical method for the quantification, by LC/MS/ MS, of araCTP and its two natural nucleoside triphosphate competitors (CTP and dCTP) in human cells, that we have used this method to determine the amounts of these compounds in a human lymphoma cell line after treatment with the prodrug of araCMP, and that our results indicate a high degree of selectivity of the prodrug for the target enzyme.
a sensitive LC-MS/MS method was developed for determination of araCTP in a cell culture.

the method was developed and validated for the quantification in a human lymphoma cell line of the nucleotide triphosphates formed after treatment with araC, a nucleoside analog, and an araCMP nucleoside prodrug.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a sensitive and specific LC/MS/ MS method for the quantification in a human cell line of the intracellular metabolites formed from araC and araCMP.

the development of a sensitive, selective and robust method for the simultaneous quantification of araC triphosphate, cytidine tripphosphate and deoxycyctidine triphosphate in a human lymphoma cell line.

the development of a sensitive and specific method for the simultaneous quantification of araC nucleotide triphosphates (araNTPs) and the endogenous nucleotide triphosphate pool (NTPs), which are important biomarkers in cancer research.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the described method is a sensitive and specific method that is capable of quantifying araCTP, dCTP and CTP in human cells.

a sensitive and selective method for the simultaneous quantification of intracellular araCTP, cytidine triophosphate (CTP), and deoxycydidine triophosphate in a human follicicular lymphoma cell line has been developed.

the developed and validated LC/MS/ MS method is suitable for the simultaneous quantification of araC metabolites, araCTP, and CTP and dTP in human cells and that the method can be used to determine the formation of araCTP and CTP in the presence of a prodrug.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a sensitive and selective method for the determination of araCTP in the presence of CTP and dCPTP.
a sensitive and selective method was developed for quantification of araCMP, araCTP, araCTP-glucuronide, CTP, dCTP and dCMP in human follicular lymphoid cells.

a sensitive and selective method has been developed to determine intracellular araCTP, which is the active triphosphate metabolite of the antileukemic and antitumor agent 1-beta-D-Arabinofuranosyllcytosine (araC).
The main takeaway from our work is that

this is the first report of a sensitive, selective LC/MS-based method for the quantification and determination of araCTP and dCTP and the first report of an LC/MS/ MS method that is capable of quantifying CTP in cells.

this method can be used to determine the intracellular concentrations of araCTP in human cells and can be used as a guide to the development of prodrugs that can be converted into araCMP and subsequently into araCTP.
